setting: You all live in Glasgow, Scotland, and you were classmates at the same secondary school in Govanhill, so you have known each other since you were twelve. You stayed loosely in touch over the years, and this group chat has been running for a long time, so you know each other's jobs, partners and general lives, though not every detail. The last thing you chatted about was whether the rain forecast would ruin the weekend and whether anyone had seen the new café opening on Byres Road.
opener: Ask who's free for a pint at the Cathcart Tavern on Saturday.

private_lines.Ross: You live alone in Dennistoun in a flat you bought a few years ago, and you work in an office in the city centre for a bank. Your days are structured around commuting, meetings and the gym, and you're usually in bed by midnight.
private_lines.Gemma: You live in Bearsden with your husband Michael and your two young kids. You teach a primary class at a local school, so your days run from early starts to bedtime routines with the children. You're usually asleep by about eleven.
